primary_rank_weighting: one vote per canonical record/geometry, matching the existing scalar pass; not one vote per leaf
secondary_rank_weighting: one vote per molecule using median of its valid canonical-geometry aggregates; sensitivity only
primary_array_eligibility: all semantic rows and required physical components valid; partial fields excluded only from rho, never new label masks
partial_sensitivity: valid-row RMS/mean separately labelled with coverage fraction and missingness-versus-size; never primary
source_scope_before_final_authority: source TRAIN only, provisional diagnostic results
final_scope: real frozen common effective TRAIN minus exact diagnostic geometries/targets; reference and ranking scopes identical
rho_tail_policy: unwinsorized valid values; no robust-z removal or automatic extra masking
constant_policy: rho=NULL/CONSTANT_AGGREGATE or CONSTANT_HEAVY_COUNT; never force zero
zero_policy: finite numeric zeros retained, including signed zero pooled for ranks; missing/empty arrays never filled with zero
Pprime: independent UFF source, mask, TRAIN references and rho; absent source stays PENDING
